SELECT p.product_id AS productId, b.brand_name AS brandName, p.product_name AS productName, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, p.price,
NVL((SELECT image_url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.product_id AND ROWNUM = 1), 'https://via.placeholder.com/400') AS imageUrl, NVL(r.avg_rating, 0) AS avgRating, NVL(r.review_count, 0) AS reviewCount FROM product p JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating, COUNT(review_id) AS review_count FROM review GROUP BY product_id ) r ON p.product_id = r.product_id ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE FETCH FIRST 16 ROWS ONLY
